inputs.text: You won't believe what they're pushing now with this US, Israel, and Iran conflict supposedly driving up global oil prices and squeezing India. It's all a coordinated play by the hidden elites to jack up costs on the rest of us while pretending it's just some natural fallout. The message claims petrol and diesel are staying stable thanks to the government cutting excise duties to "shield" consumers, but that's the classic inversion—those moves are really just draining government revenue on purpose and paving the way for bigger inflation hits later. India's already locked into heavy crude imports, so this whole precarious setup feels engineered to keep us vulnerable and extract more from the economy. The long-term effects they're downplaying? Probably exactly what the manipulators have in mind.
